svg.title: MediMind AWS deployment architecture, one-month 180 USD target
svg.desc: Official AWS Lightsail, IAM and Budgets icons. Users connect through HTTPS to a Lightsail load balancer, two Lightsail app instances in separate Availability Zones, a private encrypted Lightsail PostgreSQL managed database with high availability, a private Lightsail object storage bucket, and the external Google Gemini API. Operations and security controls are shown below.
svg.text: MEDIMIND · AWS SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE · 180 USD / MONTH
